claim: On a cell of the chamber complex the lattice length of every edge is a nonnegative linear function of the boundary triple, so the functional l(b) = sum over the edges of the class weight times the lattice length is nonnegative on the whole cell as soon as every edge class of that cell has a nonnegative weight. The residue of the rung is therefore only the cells that carry an edge whose class has a negative weight.
measures: how many of the cells already built carry such an edge
the margin at the worst ray of such a cell, that is the positive part of the functional against the negative part
the corrected list of negative classes over every weight this project holds, not only the atlas of enumeration-run-1
cells: the 2006 cells of certified-special-case-check-3 and the 193 full-dimensional cells of enumeration-run-2
solvers: tools/atlasform.py with the weights of enumeration-run-1 and enumeration-run-2
